home.heroSubtitle: Point at food. Result in 3 seconds.

dangerZone.title: The danger zone
dangerZone.body: Bacteria multiply fastest between 4–60°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours of cooking.

pestoSealedVsOpen.title: Pesto: sealed vs open
pestoSealedVsOpen.body: A sealed jar keeps for months. Once opened, use within about 5–7 days — or freeze it.

eggsKeepLonger.title: Eggs keep longer than you think
eggsKeepLonger.body: Refrigerated eggs are usually good 3–5 weeks past purchase. Float test: fresh ones sink.

herbsLoveWater.title: Herbs love water
herbsLoveWater.body: Stand fresh herbs upright in a glass of water, loosely covered — they last about twice as long.

washBerriesLast.title: Wash berries last
washBerriesLast.body: Moisture speeds up mould. Only rinse berries right before you eat them.

bananas.name: Bananas
bananas.store: On the counter, away from other fruit

eggs.name: Eggs
eggs.store: In the carton, on a shelf (not the door)

leafyGreens.name: Leafy greens
leafyGreens.store: Wrapped loosely in a dry towel

bread.name: Bread
bread.store: Paper bag at room temp, or freeze

carrots.name: Carrots
carrots.store: Tops removed, in water or a sealed bag

gordonRamsay.name: Gordon Ramsay
gordonRamsay.tip: Taste as you go. Season in layers, not all at the end.

massimoBottura.name: Massimo Bottura
massimoBottura.tip: Yesterday's bread becomes today's masterpiece — never waste it.

juliaChild.name: Julia Child
juliaChild.tip: Don't crowd the pan — give food room or it steams instead of browns.

yotamOttolenghi.name: Yotam Ottolenghi
yotamOttolenghi.tip: A squeeze of lemon at the end wakes up almost any dish.

marcoPierreWhite.name: Marco Pierre White
marcoPierreWhite.tip: Let meat rest after cooking — the juices redistribute.

nigellaLawson.name: Nigella Lawson
nigellaLawson.tip: Freeze herbs in olive oil in an ice tray before they wilt.

thomasKeller.name: Thomas Keller
thomasKeller.tip: Pat proteins dry before searing — moisture is the enemy of a crust.

saminNosrat.name: Samin Nosrat
saminNosrat.tip: Salt from a height so it falls evenly across the food.

smellTestLies.title: The smell test lies
smellTestLies.body: Dangerous bacteria like salmonella don't change how food smells, looks or tastes.

dangerZone.title: The danger zone
dangerZone.body: Bacteria multiply fastest between 4–60°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

ripenWithApples.title: Ripen with apples
ripenWithApples.body: Apples and bananas release ethylene — keep them away from greens to slow spoilage.

freezingPausesTime.title: Freezing pauses time
freezingPausesTime.body: Freezing doesn't kill bacteria, it just stops them. They wake up when thawed.
